tasks.short: Document RFID equipment and process details.

steps.what: Collect actual RFID equipment configurations, process maps and available commissioning records
outputs: selected source revisions and documentation gaps

steps.what: Document equipment and process details of RFID technology using native templates and selected configuration fields
inputs: selected source revisions and documentation gaps
outputs: draft RFID equipment and process documentation

steps.what: Verify undocumented process details with operators and capture missing equipment facts and explanatory diagrams
inputs: draft RFID equipment and process documentation

steps.what: Review the complete documentation for accuracy, revision consistency and access and approve its final version
Commit the approved RFID equipment and process documentation to the controlled internal repository

tasks.design: Configure native documentation templates in {DOCS} and selected field reuse from {OTHER}, the RFID reader configuration and middleware suite. The specialist selects actual revisions, authors explanations and fills gaps through equipment inspection and operator discussion. Native field insertion reduces recopying rather than generating unobserved behavior. The complete final document receives review before a distinct controlled repository commit. Edits void approval. No notification or external publication is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Configuration values and commissioning details are recopied into documentation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exports, controlled templates and revision links offer deterministic reuse.
tasks.still_hard: Undocumented workarounds and equipment changes must be found physically.
tasks.human_edge: Explain the real process and recognize where the records are wrong.
tasks.altitude: Document assembly around retained fact finding and authorship.

reach.learn: Use the controlled configuration revision and actual process notes.

evidence.claim: Reader configuration exports and controlled templates can reuse known fields in technical documentation.

assumptions: Normal commissioning produces source records; s1 checks them and s3 counts all missing-fact capture and operator dialogue.
Native templates are tested before custom assembly.
research_questions: How much equipment documentation is repeated field entry?

already_counted.description: Missing-fact capture and final document review remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain export mappings and document templates.

approvals.approved_version: approved RFID documentation version including source revisions, repository and access

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: ten collection and fourteen repeated-documentation hours saved less two upkeep. Low: native functions already remove most copying. Same-repository commitment retains full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Define and compare project RFID solutions.

steps.what: Define possible RFID solutions and project-specific comparison criteria including read conditions, integration, support and cost
outputs: defined solution alternatives and comparison rules

steps.what: Collect verified solution specifications, existing test results and dated cost quotations
inputs: defined solution alternatives and comparison rules
supplier documents and available project tests

steps.what: Compare possible RFID solutions with transparent requirement filters and cost calculations
inputs: defined solution alternatives and comparison rules
outputs: calculated comparison matrix with unresolved criteria

steps.what: Interpret the comparison, challenge sensitivity to uncertain facts and write the project selection advice
inputs: calculated comparison matrix with unresolved criteria
outputs: final proposed RFID solution comparison and advice

steps.what: Approve the complete comparison and advice for the internal project selection record
inputs: final proposed RFID solution comparison and advice

steps.what: Commit the approved comparison and selection advice to the internal project record

tasks.design: Configure a source-linked comparison register in {OTHER}, the engineering solution catalogue, and native formulas and filters in {SPREADSHEET}. The specialist defines real alternatives, captures missing supplier facts and evaluates uncertainty. Deterministic calculations compare known facts without inventing a weighted score or inferring field performance. The human writes the final advice in {DOCS}, reviews it, then separately commits the approved record. Changes void approval. No purchasing or supplier message is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specifications and cost comparisons are repeatedly assembled by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Native structured catalogues and transparent formulas can remove comparison copying.
tasks.still_hard: A nominally compliant solution may fail under actual site conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Judge uncertainty and decide what evidence is needed before selection.

ambition.what: Compare current solution alternatives more consistently.

tasks.altitude: Deterministic evidence comparison with human selection advice.

reach.learn: Use dated costs and explicit unresolved requirements.

evidence.claim: Structured registers and spreadsheet formulas can compare verified specification and cost fields deterministically.

assumptions: s2 includes manual supplier-document reading and missing fact capture; no prepared comparison is demanded from others.
Existing requirements and site evidence originate in discovery tasks; no new site study is claimed here.
unknowns: Availability of comparable verified supplier facts.
research_questions: Which comparisons are repeat calculations and which need additional tests?

already_counted.description: Fact collection and final advice review remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain comparison fields and formula checks.

approvals.approved_version: approved solution comparison version including advice, evidence and project record target

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: ten collection and fifteen equipment-comparison hours saved less two upkeep. Low: native comparison already works, leaving only upkeep recovery. Same-project-record commitment retains full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define RFID model assumptions and capture required geometry, materials, reader settings and calibration observations
inputs: site records and available physical measurements
outputs: verified model inputs and explicit assumptions

steps.what: Create simulations or models of RFID systems using native reusable reader, antenna and scene components
inputs: verified model inputs and explicit assumptions
outputs: configured RFID model and parameter set

steps.what: Set up parameter sweeps, run the local simulation and inspect run failures using native batch settings
inputs: configured RFID model and parameter set

steps.what: Validate model behavior against physical observations and write its selection and configuration implications and limits
inputs: verified model inputs and explicit assumptions
outputs: final model package with validation and interpretation

steps.what: Approve the final simulation package, validation limits and internal model record version
inputs: final model package with validation and interpretation

steps.what: Commit the approved model, inputs, outputs and interpretation to the internal engineering repository

tasks.design: Configure native component libraries and parameter sweeps in {OTHER}, the RF propagation and RFID simulation software with its model repository. The specialist obtains inputs and checks their meaning, adapts the model, validates outputs and writes implications in {DOCS}. Reusable scenes and batch settings reduce setup rather than replace physics validation. Saving the final controlled package is distinct and gated after final review. Revised inputs or model settings cancel approval. No runtime reduction is counted as labour savings and no live reader configuration is changed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated model geometry and scenario setup.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable components and parameter-sweep configurations offer deterministic reuse.
tasks.still_hard: Material uncertainty and actual RF behavior can invalidate a plausible model.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a valid abstraction and explain where simulation cannot establish real performance.

ambition.what: Explore current configuration alternatives with reproducible models.

tasks.altitude: Native simulation setup improvement with retained validation.

reach.learn: Use explicit model assumptions and physical discrepancies.

evidence.claim: RF simulation tools commonly support reusable components and parameter sweeps; actual library and automation support require local confirmation.

assumptions: Shares are provisional and count human setup and inspection only.
s1 counts missing measurements and input capture; existing site records are reused where available.
Component libraries are checked before reuse and upkeep is counted below.
unknowns: How much existing geometry and component data is reusable.
research_questions: Do reused models remain valid when checked against actual read conditions?

already_counted.description: Input verification, physical validation and final review.

incremental.description: Maintain validated model components and sweep presets.

approvals.approved_version: approved RFID model version including inputs, results, limits and repository target

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: twelve model-setup and7.5 sweep-setup hours saved less two upkeep. Low: existing native libraries remove most new benefit. Same-engineering-repository commitment retains full effort.

steps.what: Retrieve authorized RFID event and supply-chain transaction extracts for the analysis window
inputs: existing reader events and operational transactions
outputs: timestamped source extracts and coverage gaps

steps.what: Reconcile tag identifiers, duplicate reads, clock offsets and missing event coverage without inferring unseen movements
inputs: timestamped source extracts and coverage gaps
outputs: reconciled analysis dataset and exception register

steps.what: Calculate RFID supply-chain counts, observed dwell intervals and coverage indicators using explicit rules
inputs: reconciled analysis dataset and exception register

steps.what: Analyze RFID-related supply-chain data and investigate operational interpretations and missing-read alternatives
inputs: reconciled analysis dataset and exception register

steps.what: Write the analysis note with actual findings, supporting indicators and explicit uncertainty
Approve the final analysis note and its internal record destination
Commit the approved analysis note and dataset references to the internal analytics record

tasks.design: Use native exports from {OTHER}, the RFID event middleware, and {OPS_SYSTEM}; configure repeatable joins and exception rules in {DATA_PLATFORM}. {BI} calculates transparent counts, observed intervals and coverage indicators. The specialist investigates unknown mappings and logs, interprets actual supply-chain behavior and writes the note in {DOCS}. A final approval precedes separate record commitment. Changes void approval. No model fabricates missing events or automatically changes inventory or shipment status.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated extraction, duplicate-read handling and manual metric calculation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exports and deterministic query pipelines can make recurring analysis reproducible.
tasks.still_hard: A missed read is not proof of a missed movement; causality remains uncertain.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret incomplete event coverage against actual operating conditions.

ambition.what: Analyze existing RFID supply-chain events consistently.

tasks.altitude: A deterministic analytics pipeline with retained operational interpretation.

reach.learn: Separate observed intervals from inferred movements.

evidence.claim: RFID event middleware, query tools and BI platforms can export, reconcile and aggregate structured events deterministically.

assumptions: Readers and normal operational transactions produce raw inputs. s1 and s2 retain export checks, manual mapping gaps and exception capture; no new clean input work is shifted to operators.
The proposed analysis contains no employee performance scoring.
unknowns: Event coverage and tag-to-item mapping reliability.
research_questions: Which conclusions survive explicit missing-read sensitivity checks?

already_counted.description: Reconciliation and final note review remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain event schemas, mapping rules and metric regression checks.

approvals.approved_version: approved supply-chain analysis version with dataset references and internal record target

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: twelve extraction,12.5 reconciliation and twenty calculation hours saved less three upkeep. Low: current native analytics covers all those steps and upkeep alone remains. Same-analytics-record commitment retains full effort.
